name: Empty-stage dip
visual_intent: A section turn the viewer feels: the content sinks away, the empty stage breathes for a beat, and the next title arrives on the first word of the next phrase.

performance_characteristics.memory_profile: Low (<5MB); transforms and opacity only (estimate, not measured on the M2)

implementation_summary: Outgoing group fades and sinks over 0.3 s (power2.in) ending `hold` (0.25 s) before `at`; the incoming group rises in at `at` (or is just shown when the caller animates its title). Warns over 0.5 s of hold. The background must keep moving through the hold.
runtime_api: Studio.fx.dip(tl, outGroup, inGroup, at, {exit 0.3, hold 0.25, entrance: 'rise' | 'none'})

validation.evidence: Runtime checks tests/studio-runtime/explain-devices.html (63 checks incl. seek-order independence) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-11-28; golden scene tests/reference-derived/explain-tour-progression/index.html frame review 0 errors 0 warnings and contact sheet inspected. Not rendered through HyperFrames on the M2, so not approved.
